title: Build the advantage and the clip
brief: Compute the probability ratio, the normalised advantage, and PPO's clipped objective, then check that the clip stops pulling exactly where it should.
hints: policy_ratio is np.exp(new_logps - old_logps). Subtract first, then exponentiate.
advantage: raw = rewards - values; return (raw - raw.mean()) / (raw.std() + 1e-8). With raw all equal the std is 0 and the result must be all zeros.
clipped_objective: np.mean(np.minimum(ratio * advantage, np.clip(ratio, 1 - eps, 1 + eps) * advantage)). Use minimum, so a bad answer whose ratio rose above 1 + eps keeps its full penalty.
